items.summary: A Democratic sweep and a new Texas governor who wants to pause data center construction sent AI-infrastructure stocks tumbling. Here's what changed, and what didn't.

items.title: Constellation Energy Sinks 8%, Vistra Down 14% as Democrats’ Midterm Sweep Hits AI Power Stocks
items.summary: Key TakeawaysConstellation Energy fell 8% this morning after Democrats won Congress, in a selloff that also hit Vistra, GE Vernova and CoreWeave. Its signed deals with Alphabet’s Google and Amazon still stand, so the risk is in future contracts.

items.title: GE Vernova Sinks 10%, Vistra Down 12% as Democrats Win Congress: “Incrementally More Negative Sentiment”
items.summary: Key TakeawaysGE Vernova fell 10% today, with Vistra and Constellation Energy, after Democrats won both chambers of Congress. Only about 20% of GE Vernova’s contracted gas turbine capacity serves data centers.

items.title: Vertiv Sinks 9%, GE Vernova Down 8% as Democrats Win Congress, Reviving Data Center Fears
items.summary: Key TakeawaysVertiv fell 9% today after Democrats won Congress, dragging GE Vernova, Eaton and CoreWeave down too. Developers will still need Vertiv’s gear even if they pay more for power, so the selloff looks overdone.

items.title: Vistra Sinks 10%, Constellation Down 6% as Democrats’ “Blue Tsunami” Hits AI Power Stocks
items.summary: Key TakeawaysVistra stock fell 10% today after Democrats won Congress and Texas, pulling Constellation Energy, GE Vernova and Vertiv down too. Texas Governor-elect Gina Hinojosa campaigned on a moratorium on new data centers.
